text:
emma: Heads-up — I opened a small docs PR to fix a couple of SDK snippets that were giving confusing behavior for streaming + pagination + retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
raj: thanks, will take a look this afternoon. which languages?
sasha: Python, TS, and Go from a quick glance. Go snippet has a context/cancel leak and the retry loop didn't handle partial pages.
emma: yep — Python and TS had an async iterator example that didn't show backoff jitter; Go was missing Close/Cancel. I kept the changes minimal so it's easy to review.
raj: paste the problematic go snippet here?
sasha: sure — current code in PR shows:
```go
resp, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for event := range resp.Events {
  fmt.Println(event.Text)
}
// no Close or cancel shown
```
sasha: change should be more like:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
defer cancel()
resp, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
defer resp.Close()
for { 
  ev, ok := resp.Next()
  if !ok { break }
  fmt.Println(ev.Text)
}
```
sasha: also added a small note about handling partial pagination results when a retry happens in the middle of a page.
emma: TS side — I rewrote the example to use the async iterator + a small retry wrapper so it's idiomatic. snippet:
```ts
for await (const chunk of client.stream(request)) {
  // handle chunk
}
// retry wrapper uses exponential backoff with jitter
```
emma: I included a short paragraph explaining why jitter matters for hot paths.
jordan: can we add a unit test or an integration example for the Python pagination case? a minimal pytest that mocks a partial page and asserts the retry resumes correctly would help prevent regressions.
raj: good call. I'll add a tiny test in sdk-examples/tests/test_pagination_retry.py after the doc changes land unless you want it in the PR, emma.
emma: if you're adding tests, drop them in the PR — easier to review together. I'm adding a note in the PR description to run that test locally.
docs-bot: linked PR 4123 to ticket DOCS-298 and flagged for review by @raj, @sasha.
raj: quick nit — update the Python snippet to show session-level timeout vs per-call timeout. small comment.
emma: done, pushed a patch. also added an inline TODO to follow up with a longer migration note for users upgrading from older SDKs.
sasha: LGTM from eng side once CI passes. I left one comment about the retry backoff constants (use 100ms base, 2x multiplier, max 5s).
emma: thanks — I'll squash and merge once tests are green and @raj approves.
raj: approving now, happy to merge after green CI. :thumbsup:
emma: merging after deploy bot finishes. thanks all for quick turnaround!
docs-bot: CI status: pending — will post update on completion.
